log.old: The city prefect Leontius ordered the arrest of a charioteer; the crowd rioted and burned the house of the prefect's office, and when a ringleader, Peter Valvomeres, harangued them, Leontius had him seized at the Septizodium, a much-frequented place, and flogged.
log.new: The city prefect Leontius had the popular charioteer Philoromus arrested and the rioters punished; when the plebs gathered again at the Septizodium, a much-frequented place, complaining of a wine shortage, Leontius went there in person, picked out the ringleader Peter Valvomeres, had him strung up and flogged, and the crowd melted away.
log.reason: Ammianus 15.7.1-5 describes no house burned; the arrest of Philoromus, the wine-shortage riot at the Septizodium and the seizing of Peter Valvomeres are the content. (The burning of a prefect's house is Lampadius' story, Amm. 27.3.8.)

log.old: Rebuilt under Hadrian (about 113 to 125) with Agrippa's name restored on the pediment. The unreinforced concrete dome spans 43.3 m, still the largest of its kind.
log.new: Begun around 113 under Trajan and completed under Hadrian by about 125, with Agrippa's name restored in the inscription on the porch frieze. The unreinforced concrete dome spans 43.3 m, still the largest of its kind.
log.reason: Hadrian acceded in 117, so a start in 113 is Trajanic (brick stamps); the Agrippa inscription is on the frieze of the porch, not the pediment.
log.source: CIL VI 896; Hetland, 'Dating the Pantheon', JRA 20 (2007)

log.old: Under the Antonines Rome held perhaps a million people. Eleven aqueducts brought water, and apartment blocks rose to the legal limit of about 60 feet set by Trajan.
log.new: Under the Antonines Rome held perhaps a million people. Ten aqueducts brought water, and apartment blocks rose to the legal limit of about 60 feet set by Trajan.
log.reason: In 135 there were ten aqueducts (Frontinus' nine plus the Aqua Traiana of 109); the eleventh, the Aqua Alexandrina, dates from 226.
log.source: Frontinus, De aquaeductu 4-15; Fasti Ostienses for 109
